brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: Configurator verifies geometry (meshClash=clear) not structural load. Build provides 3 contiguous full-hex shelves at level 1 (covers on pieces -1,0,1; 0,0,1; 1,0,1) over a 3-wide base, but catalog contains no load-rating data and instructions explicitly forbid claiming load ratings. No verification for 50 kg is possible in this environment.

Two drawer units placed on half-s bases: drawer:0#-1,1#cut at -1,1,0 and drawer:0#1,1#cut at 1,1,0, both offered via find_sockets drawer offers and confirmed present in get_build with meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Built a 3-wide two-level shelf unit with covers as shelf surfaces on level 1 and two drawers on half-s bases at ground level. Geometry verified clear. The 50 kg rating cannot be verified or claimed by the Hex Cluster configurator, per its fit-only scope.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
